# Caramel Frontend-First Workflow

1. Inspect the repository.
2. Confirm the stack and preview command.
3. Agree brand, content and page direction.
4. Build static frontend pages.
5. Review the local preview.
6. Approve the static version.
7. Approve a migration manifest if migration is wanted.
8. Run a migration dry run.
9. Approve generation.
10. Generate into a new target.
11. Validate technically.
12. Compare visually with the static version.
13. Approve dynamic features separately.
14. Approve delivery separately.

The agent must stop whenever a phase has not been approved.
